securityNotes: Prose-only skill: no scripts, no binaries; 18 markdown files total (SKILL.md 160 KB, 15 references, 2 READMEs). Grepped every file for hidden instructions, ignore-user-rules phrasing, exfiltration, and secrecy patterns: clean - all 'hidden'/'dark pattern' hits are legitimate audit content (dark-pattern detection, a11y). Network activity is agent-mediated web_fetch of user-supplied URLs (live sites, GitHub raw, CodeSandbox/StackBlitz/CodePen debug views, Storybook), inherent to the audit purpose; no fixed third-party endpoints beyond those user inputs. One caveat worth a curator note: the URL Input Spec (SKILL.md lines 88-95) offers that the user may 'share credentials and I'll attempt the authenticated experience' for login-walled pages (it does instruct never to repeat credentials in the report) - soliciting credentials in chat is a practice we may want to strip or annotate if this is ever vendored. Figma MCP write paths (F5 'Fix Directly in Figma') act only on explicit user request per the reference's safe-editing patterns.
overlaps: impeccable (not-vendored-keeper, this pipeline): its audit/critique commands cover similar ground; other design-review/audit candidates in the pipeline likely overlap - generic-name collision risk is low since upstream name is design-auditor
contentAssessment: Genuinely strong audit skill, not a prompt dump: 19 categories with per-category checklists and concrete numeric thresholds (WCAG 4.5:1/3:1, 8pt grid, 44px touch targets, nested-radius formula outer = inner + padding); an explicit scoring formula (100 - blockers*12 - criticals*8 - warnings*4 - tips*1, arithmetic shown) with a principled Blocker-vs-Critical distinction (citable WCAG/GDPR provision = Blocker); required issue deduplication with node-ID grouping; severity calibrated by project stage (early concept / dev handoff / production); input handling for Figma MCP, live URLs, GitHub, sandboxes, Storybook, screenshots, and pasted code with per-source confidence levels; framework and design-system detection (MUI, Chakra, shadcn/ui, Ant, Radix, Bootstrap); a strict output template; wireframe-to-spec and developer-handoff modes; bilingual EN/KR output. Conformance held at 1: non-spec frontmatter field 'version'; SKILL.md body is 160 KB / 2,770 lines (severe context bloat for a skill body); coupling to Claude.ai-host widget tools (Visualizer, ask_user_input, Canva export) - all with documented fallbacks; claude-ai must NOT be added to compatibility (non-spec frontmatter field present).
